title: Absorb g copies of the heavy slice by the factor-1 gate (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

The `g` copies of one heavy slice fit the factor-1 gate. For integers `p ≥ 2`, `g ≥ 1`, `K ≥ 0` and `C ≥ 0`, whenever `p ≥ max(64, 4K + 2C)` and `g ceil(log2 p) ≤ p`, those copies are strictly below `2^{-C p}`. The exponent is at most `-C p - 1`.

#4693 puts one slice strictly below `2^{E_0}` with `E_0 = 10 g L + 1 + 2 K p - p^2`. The gate forces `g ≤ 2^L`: if `g ≥ 2^L + 1`, then `g L ≥ (2^L + 1) L > p`. It does not always force `g < 2^L`. At `p = 2` and `g = 2`, `g = 2^L`. The slice bound is already strict, so the copies stay strictly below `2^{E_0 + L}`. The eighths spend `80 p`. The new `8 L` is at most `p` for `p ≥ 64`. The linear term is at most `4 p^2`. The polynomial `4 p^2 - 81 p - 16` equals `11184` at `p = 64` and increases by `8 p - 77`.

At `p = 84` and `g = 12`, `g L = 84 ≤ 84` while `2 g L = 168 > 84`, and the copies exponent is `-6208`. This `1` multiplies `g L`. It is not a one-bit majorant of the ceiling `9` and not a two-power majorant of `C`. The coefficient-9 monomials in #4495 still use `16 g L ≤ p`, because `9 > 8`. At `p = 2` and `g = 1` the factor holds, but `p < 64`. Since `e < 3`, the one copy `1088 exp(-4)` is larger than `1`.

No smaller positive integer coefficient of `g L` remains. A fractional coefficient is a different gate and is not posed here. The trailing bound `p^{10}`, the section error, and the ceiling `9 p^2` stay hypotheses. This package does not prove `||H^{-1}||_2 ≤ p^{10}`. No new κ. The selected record is `60403/20000000`. This answers the open question of #4693. It branches from fetched main and does not replay that unmerged package.

## Test plan

- [x] Prints `PASS_GAUSSIAN_SLICE_ONE_COPIES` and `outcome=completed`
- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run

Base `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`, priority revision 7. Upstream fetched at 2026-10-22T16:11:48Z was that commit. The pre-submit fetches at 2026-10-22T16:15:10Z and 2026-10-22T16:15:25Z were the same commit, and the pinned blobs match. κ remains `60403/20000000`.
